title: 一个集装箱从船到货架（导览）
titleEn: One container from ship to shelf (guided tour)
description: 一分钟的自动导览：镜头跟着一个集装箱，从班轮靠泊、卸船、堆场、拖车、配送中心，一直到门店货架。
descriptionEn: A one-minute guided tour: the camera follows one container from berthing and discharge through the yard, a truck and the distribution centre to the store shelf.
